  @IsString()

  @IsOptional()

  orderId?: string;

  @Type(() => InvoiceLineItemDto)

  @IsOptional()

}

### 8. API Endpoints Summary
Ensure all these endpoints are implemented with proper authentication, validation, and error handling:

**User Endpoints:**
- `POST /api/wallets/me/deposit` - Create wallet deposit
- `POST /api/wallets/me/deposit/verify` - Verify wallet deposit
- `GET /api/wallets/me/receipts` - Get user receipts
- `GET /api/invoices/me` - Get user invoices
- `POST /api/invoices/:id/pay` - Pay invoice from wallet
- `GET /api/receipts/:id/verify` - Verify receipt

**Admin Endpoints:**
- `GET /api/admin/wallets` - List all wallets
- `GET /api/admin/invoices` - List all invoices
- `POST /api/admin/invoices` - Create manual invoice
- `GET /api/admin/transactions` - List all transactions
- `GET /api/admin/receipts` - List all receipts
